title: Kapton® Polyimide Films: The Gold Standard for Versatility and Performance
summary: Qnity (formerly DuPont Electronics) Kapton® Polyimide Films: The Gold Standard for Versatility and Performance
body_markdown:
*Figure 2. Summary listing of Kapton® polyimide films.*


The versatility of Kapton® film extends to its coloration, with some products being available in black or white to absorb or reflect light, respectively, as needed by an application. The James Webb Space Telescope’s massive solar shield, for example, is made of five thin layers of Kapton® E film with aluminum and doped-silicon coatings to reflect the sun's heat back into space.


**Technical expertise and application development**


What sets Qnity(formerly DuPont Electronics) apart is not just our films’ superior performance, but also the breadth of technical expertise and application development that comes with it. Qnity(formerly DuPont Electronics) collaborates closely with OEMs and designers to understand their evolving needs and develop new formulations that push the boundaries of technology. Always building on our success, we continue to evolve the capabilities of Kapton® polyimides film in concert with our customers’ changing needs.


This dedication to innovation, coupled with Qnity’s ability to scale production globally, ensures that customers receive reliable materials that reduce risk and improve product performance, no matter how extreme the conditions.


**Why choose Qnity(formerly DuPont Electronics)?**


If you’re in need of high-performance films that deliver unmatched reliability in the harshest environments, Kapton® and Oasis® are the gold standards. With over 50 years of proven success, Qnity’s materials continue to lead the industry, backed by technical expertise, cutting-edge innovation, and a commitment to helping customers achieve the impossible.


**Whether you’re advancing the future of electronics, aerospace, or automotive design, Kapton® and Oasis® materials are your trusted partners for high-performance solutions.**
